sum: Agility Robotics, Inc. manufactures humanoid robots and cloud-based fleet management software for industrial automation. The company produces Digit, a humanoid robot designed for warehouse and industrial environments to automate repetitive material handling tasks. It also offers Agility Arc, a cloud platform that coordinates, manages, and monitors fleets of humanoid robots across customer deployments. The company integrates its humanoid robotics hardware with its artificial intelligence stack and fleet management software to automate workflows in industrial facilities. It serves warehouse, logistics, and manufacturing operators. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Salem, Oregon.
